items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: And so I said, Snoozer, I want you to shake hands with Mr. Whiteman.

ctx.x: And that was so astounding that I have never seen Paul Whiteman's stomach shake so, you know, all my life. A laugh. You know, if you could get anything on anybody, old Pops would, he'd stand back there and he'd really give you a big belly laugh, in other words. He had the equipment. Oh, he had the equipment. And he'd really, he'd really, he was a wonderful person. And like when Snoozer Quinn, he came backstage at St. Charles Theatre. And Snoozer could play, you know, play without, play with his fingers on the, on…
